candidate_numbering: one-based index in the original 40-candidate context montage
review_basis: manual inspection of whether a coherent real ion spectral ridge is visible between the two black candidate-boundary lines

expanded_review.review_basis: manual inspection inside the black candidate-boundary lines; adjusted intervals replace the automatic eight-minute boundaries

approve_adjusted_interval.manual_change: manual interval 15:05-15:15 UTC replaces automatic 15:08-15:16 window

features: time-mean H+ DEF peak divided by the median over energy
reference_classifier.decision_rule: classify a real spectrum only when both features exceed threshold; otherwise classify a pure-background reference
reference_classifier.borderline_policy: scores within 10 percent of one require manual review

boundary_refinement.selection_rule: retain the longest high-confidence subwindow passing gross-coherence and quality checks; break equal-duration ties by lowest decision score; otherwise reject
boundary_refinement.result: all 8 borderline candidates reached high confidence after trimming
boundary_refinement.manual_override_policy: manual adjusted boundaries for expanded candidates 1, 7, and 16 take precedence; automatic boundaries are used for previously full-approved borderline candidates

model_policy: Do not promote a production background model until exact ori/quality validation passes and at least one additional clean interval raises the accepted total to 20.
